'''Mustafa Babanlı''' ({{langx|az|Mustafa Baba oğlu Babanlı}}; born February 21, 1968), is an Azerbaijani scientist, Rector of the [[Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University]].

On September 3, 2015, Mustafa Babanli was appointed Rector of the [[Azerbaijan State University of Oil and Industry]].<ref>[http://en.apa.az/xeber_rector_of_azerbaijan_state_university_of_231540.html Rector of the Azerbaijan State University of Oil and Industry appointed]</ref><ref>[http://report.az/en/domestic-politics/president-of-azerbaijan-renames-state-oil-academy/ Azerbaijani President renames State Oil Academy]</ref> He is a member of the [[International Association of University Presidents]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://iaup.org/membership/member-list |title=Member List |accessdate=2014-04-04 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140404115155/http://iaup.org/membership/member-list |archivedate=2014-04-04 }}</ref> serving as Regional Chair for Middle East, Caucasus & Central Asia.<ref>[https://www.iaup.org/leadership/executive-committee/ IAUP Executive Committee]</ref>
